verdict.rationale: ADP's own docs say RUN can export journal entries into QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file without re-keying data. That is the product's own capability, but it is framed as an export rather than an automatic, ongoing sync. missing for 10: evidence of automatic or scheduled journal-entry sync (versus manual export), details on GL account mapping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
